name: architect-agent-desktop
description: A cross-platform desktop workspace with a built-in multi-tab web browser.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n VITE,TSC,ELECTRON "vite --host 127.0.0.1" "tsc -p tsconfig.electron.json --watch" "wait-on tcp:5173 dist/main/index.js && cross-env VITE_DEV_SERVER_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5173 electron ."
scripts.build: npm run clean && npm run typecheck && vite build && tsc -p tsconfig.electron.json
scripts.package:mac: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build && npm run test:layout:run && electron-builder --mac dmg zip --publish never
scripts.package:win: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build && npm run test:layout:run && electron-builder --win nsis --publish never
scripts.test:layout: npm run build && npm run test:layout:run
scripts.package: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build && npm run test:layout:run && electron-builder --publish never
